meta.title: Validation gates G1–G10 (mandatory for reward eligibility)

gates.name: Provenance
gates.requirement: Every input row carries an official, verifiable source URL; transcribed values re-checked against source.

gates.name: No leakage / pre-registration
gates.requirement: Model, parameters and strategy registered (git-committed) before the events settle; chronological walk-forward only.

gates.name: Sample size ≥ 300 graded games
gates.status: FAIL (n far below 300 for every strategy)

gates.name: Beat baselines
gates.requirement: Beat (a) home-always, (b) favorite-always, (c) naive flat model on Brier/MAE with paired test.

gates.name: Calibration ECE ≤ 0.10
gates.requirement: 10-bin expected calibration error on walk-forward predictions.

gates.name: Registry completeness
gates.requirement: Strategy in registry with hash-tagged params before first evaluation.

gates.name: Market comparison
gates.requirement: Edge vs a real, time-stamped operator line from a verifiable source; lines captured pre-game.
gates.status: BLOCKED (no official/verifiable line archive in workspace)

gates.name: Costs & settlement
gates.requirement: ROI measured net of vig and push rules, settled on official final scores/stats.

gates.name: Correlation control
gates.requirement: Parlay/prop legs priced from measured joint distribution; report r, 95% CI, p; ban independence assumption when |r|>0.10 or p<0.05.
gates.status: FAIL for prop combos (no data — r BLANK); design PASS otherwise

gates.name: Multiple testing / luck removal
gates.requirement: Benjamini–Hochberg FDR across all reported tests; permutation test on headline metric; luck quantified vs null.
